issues.description: The template's Bitmap24 class declaration (example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp) declares only the parameterized constructor Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height), but the implementation file (example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp) defines a default no-argument constructor Bitmap24::Bitmap24() and main.cpp constructs Bitmap24 using the default constructor (Bitmap24 bitmap;). This mismatch (no default ctor declared in the header while it is defined and used) will lead to compilation errors and confuses students about the intended class interface. The solution repository's header does declare the default constructor, showing the intended API.
issues.suggestedFix: Declare the default constructor in the template header to match the implementation and usage (add 'Bitmap24();' to example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp), or alternatively remove the default constructor definition and adjust main.cpp to use the parameterized constructor. Align the template header with the implementation and the solution (which already declares the default constructor).
